name: Ki-rin

actions.name: Call Lightning
actions.effect: A bolt of divine lightning strikes a point within 36m. All creatures in a 3m radius must pass PHYS save for half. Can be repeated each turn for 1 minute as a 1-action cost.

actions.name: Celestial Restoration
actions.effect: All allies within 12m heal 4d8 HP and are cured of one condition. Usable twice per encounter.

actions.name: Create Weather
actions.effect: The Ki-rin controls the weather within 5km. Can create storms, clear skies, fog, or other weather conditions.

reactions.name: Aegis of the Divine
reactions.effect: When an ally within 18m would be reduced to 0 HP, the Ki-rin can prevent the damage entirely. The ally instead has 1 HP. Usable once per encounter.

reactions.name: Magic Resistance
reactions.effect: +3d6 to a save against a spell or magical effect.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.desc: If the Ki-rin fails a save, it can choose to succeed instead. Usable twice per encounter.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc: Can cast Dispel Magic, Remove Curse, and Greater Restoration at will.

traits.name: Sacred Presence
traits.desc: Undead and fiends cannot willingly approach within 9m of the Ki-rin unless they pass a WILL save.

lore: Ki-rin are magnificent dragon-horses of celestial origin, regarded as omens of good fortune and divine favor. They control the weather and command powerful divine magic. Ancient temples are often built where a Ki-rin was sighted, and their appearance heralds great events.
